originalWorld.actionSelectionRule: At source time t before any branch reward: if t%7 is 0 or 4, take right action 1; if t%7 is 2 or 5, take left action 0; otherwise take forward action 2. This rule does not read walls, map, goal, or withheld rewards.

categoryRules.physical_revisit: Current physical (X,Y) previously exited and then subsequently returned to after leaving
categoryRules.forward_stall: Within previous eight actual public selected actions, at least two chosen forward actions had identical before and after (X,Y)
categoryRules.goal_misaligned: Dot product of public direction vector and public goal offset is <=0

originalWorld.identicalCommonContinuation: original full-public-grid BFS, expressly more informed than models

models.currentOnly: fully FIT-trained 21-dimensional frozen F9 public ridge
models.historyRidge: same fitted current state/action features plus last 12 witnessed public selected-action and motion/blocked events, physical revisit count, failed forward count and number of observed physical cells
models.historyEmpirical: FIT-trained history-conditioned return table with 16 pseudo-count FIT-trained action mean prior
models.baselineAction: FIT-trained action mean, not fixed action
models.modelInputOnly: six public fields, previous actual chosen actions and observed consequences; no privileged map, no source identity
